verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no self-serve audience export: nothing covers exporting contacts, custom attributes, tags, engagement history, or the suppression list to an open format. What exists are developer building blocks: the App API can 'fetch data', the CLI returns JSON with full workspace access, and data-out integrations send data to other platforms. A developer could build an export from these, but they are not an export feature, so they earn no credit.
